notes:
Account background: Northgate is an EU-headquartered transmission operator (large grid operator). On Redwood since 2023 (hosted API initial). Want to move the core inference for outage-chat ops and document-search to Dedicated to lower tail latency and reduce unit cost. Also evaluating Private for a future VPC control-plane in 2027.

Recent timeline:
- 2023-09: initial pilot (hosted) - embeddings for incident search (low volume).
- 2024-05: expanded to chat-based operator assistant, hit token cost spikes; asked for cost/carbon analysis.
- 2025-10: security questionnaire (SaaS + residency) completed; SOC2 in scope.
- 2026-01-18: strategy sync w/VP Ops, prioritized Dedicated reserved pool + Optimize adoption to tune batching/kv cache. (see ff-2026-01-18-NG-0049)
- 2026-02-26: technical deep-dive with SEs; confirmed quantization acceptable for reranking models; need throughput SLOs for peak incident windows. (ff-2026-02-26-NG-0110)
- 2026-03-05: procurement requested final SOW and pricing cap; legal flagged EU data residency clause.

Requirements / constraints:
- Latency target: 95th pct < 150ms for chat operator queries during incident peaks (bursty windows up to 600 qps sustained for 10m).
- Throughput: baseline 120 qps steady for embeddings batch jobs nightly; peaks as above.
- Cost: target reduce per-token cost by 35% vs hosted baseline.
- Model preferences: open Llama-2 style family for chat + a smaller encoder for embeddings. Need Redwood to guarantee compatible quantization profile.
- Routing/fallback: primary Dedicated in eu-west2, fallback to hosted (region) if capacity constrained; must preserve audit logging on fallback.
- Security: SSO (SAML), KMS integration (Azure Key Vault), retention controls (90d for ephemeral logs), comprehensive audit logs exported to their SIEM.

POC & deliverables:
- POC window: 30 days (Technical POC + perf verification). SE to deliver throughput/latency report and recommended batch sizes.
- Optimize: workshop to tune batching and KV cache (expected 20-40% cost improvement). Include baseline, config changes, and regression checks.
- Dedicated: proposal to reserve 2x p4d-equivalent capacity for 12 months with burst policy; include rollback plan.

Stakeholder notes (quotes & impressions):
- "If we can hit 95th <150ms and cut cost by ~30% we can justify the capex." — Head of Grid Automation (call 2026-01-18).
- Procurement: "Need DPA with explicit EU residency and subprocessor list; legal will redline."
- Platform team: enthusiastic about Optimize but need a one-day hands-on training for ops.

Commercials and next steps:
- Draft SOW sent 2026-03-09 (drive:/decks/ng-pricing-dedicated-2026-02.pdf). Pricing bucket under review; expect internal procurement sign-off 2–4 weeks after legal agreement.
- Next demo: live perf run against a synthetic incident workload (SE + infra) — target week of 2026-03-22.
- Ask: confirm EU-west2 Dedicated start date and hold short-term burst capacity until final sign-off.

Open risks and mitigation suggestions:
- Risk: EU region slot sold out -> Mitigation: offer short-term hosted burst at reserved pricing + SLA credits.
- Risk: Legal data residency redlines delay -> Mitigation: provide DPA template with precedent customers and accelerate CSM-led legal working session.
- Risk: Performance regressions post-quantization -> Mitigation: include model-compatibility acceptance tests and rollback to fp16 variant during rollout.

CRM activity snippets:
- 2026-03-05 email from procurement (thread-3b77e8-procurement): asking for final SOW + pricing cap.
- 2026-02-26 SE deep-dive (RDW-2128) documented perf targets and acceptance criteria.
- 2026-01-28: Optimize scoping doc shared and initial cost model.

Summary: High-value enterprise renewal + expansion. Primary motion: Dedicated reserved capacity for EU, Optimize adoption to meet unit-cost targets, legal/DPA + procurement are gating items. AE leads commercial; SE and CSM engaged for technical acceptance and onboarding.
